ev.q: Among 598 hospitalized pregnant women with COVID-19, 54.5% were asymptomatic at admission.
Women hospitalized during the first or second trimester were more frequently symptomatic (84.0%) than were those hospitalized during the third trimester (39.9%).
Among 272 hospitalized symptomatic pregnant women, 44 (16.2%) were admitted to an ICU
Overall, 272 (45.5%) pregnant women with COVID-19 were symptomatic at the time of hospital admission
preterm delivery was reported for 23.1% of symptomatic women and 8.0% of asymptomatic women
Descriptive statistics were calculated for hospitalized pregnant women with complete chart review

methods_quotes.q: Descriptive statistics were calculated for hospitalized pregnant women with complete chart review and discharge disposition
Trained surveillance officers performed medical chart abstractions for a convenience sample of hospitalizations
Data were analyzed using SAS software (version 9.4; SAS Institute)
